title: 5 Coldwater Lakes, Saggart, Co. Dublin
description:
RAY COOKE AUCTIONEERS are privileged to introduce No. 5 Coldwater Lakes to the market. Positioned within one of Saggart’s most exclusive, secure gated developments, this magnificent four-bedroom, four-bathroom detached residence spans an impressive c. 357 sq. m. (3,842 sq. ft.) of masterfully designed living space. Sitting proudly on a manicured 0.67-acre south-facing site, this home offers a rare blend of absolute privacy, countryside serenity, and village convenience.

Lovingly maintained and upgraded with no expense spared, No. 5 arrives in flawless, turnkey condition. From the sweeping entrance hallway to the extra-height ceilings, every detail has been curated to deliver an unparalleled luxury living experience.

The Accommodation
The Grand Entrance: A striking hallway featuring a bespoke staircase and gallery landing sets a dramatic and elegant tone upon arrival.

Living & Entertainment Hub: Designed for both grand-scale entertaining and intimate family life, the ground floor boasts an extra-large primary living room, a refined secondary lounge, and a dedicated, state-of-the-art private cinema room.

The Heart of the Home: An expansive open-plan kitchen and dining area features premium fully fitted cabinetry, integrated high-end appliances, and a stunning central breakfast island. A separate, practical utility room and a guest WC lie just off this space.

The Sanctuary Bedrooms: Upstairs, the light-filled gallery landing leads to four exceptionally generous double bedrooms. This includes three master suites, each boasting private balconies with scenic views, top-tier built-in wardrobes, and lavish en-suite bathrooms.

Spa-Quality Bathrooms: All bathrooms are meticulously wrapped in floor-to-ceiling premium tiling, featuring high-spec fixtures and therapeutic jacuzzi baths.

Garaging & Storage: A substantial attached garage and an additional storage room offer excellent versatility for vehicle storage, a home gym, or workshop space.

Grounds & Gardens
Set against a backdrop of picturesque, rolling countryside views, the property sits on a beautifully landscaped 0.67-acre plot. The rear of the property features a highly coveted south-facing orientation, bathed in all-day sunlight. A large, wrap-around lawn leads to a premium raised decking area—perfect for al fresco dining and entertaining guests in complete privacy.

The Location
Coldwater Lakes offers the ultimate in prestigious village living. While enjoying total peace and security, you are just a 5-minute stroll from the Luas Red Line, offering effortless access to Dublin City Centre. The N7 and M50 motorways are mere minutes away by car. Saggart Village provides an array of boutique eateries, shops, and elite schools, while the scenic trails of Rathcoole Park are right on your doorstep.

No. 5 Coldwater Lakes is a property of distinction that truly must be seen to be fully appreciated.

Contact Ray Cooke Auctioneers today to arrange your private viewing.

Premium Features at a Glance:
Internal Area: c. 357 sq. m. / 3,842 sq. ft.

Energy Efficiency: Impressive B-rated BER, ensuring excellent thermal comfort and low running costs.

The Grounds: Magnificent 0.67-acre wrap-around site with private, south-facing rear decking.

Architectural Detail: Extra-high ceilings, private bedroom balconies, and stunning gallery landing.

Bespoke Amenities: Private cinema room, three master en-suites, and attached large garage.

Premium Finishes: Fully tiled luxury bathrooms, jacuzzi baths, and custom integrated kitchen island.

Security & Location: Positioned within Saggart’s premier, highly sought-after private development.

Directions
Traveling on the N7, take the exit for Rathcoole/Saggart and take the first exit at the roundabout onto Mill Road towards Saggart. At the next roundabout, take the first exit and proceed toward the village. At the crossroads, turn left, continue for approximately 200 metres, then turn right into Tassagard. Proceed straight through the security gates, following the road to the very end, where No. 5 will be positioned directly ahead of you.
